lines.text: This is my homeland. I do not carry a permit.
Section nine, homeland clause. You are exempt. I wrote that clause. I write most of the clauses nobody reads.
You are on the Dominion side.
I stamp what I am told to stamp. I file what I am not told not to file.

choice.text: Show me the permit 7-K exemptions. I want to read them.
Sign the survey permit for my crew. Quickly.

lines.text: Appendix C. Nobody reads Appendix C. Come back at dusk and I will explain it.
Signed. And logged. You now owe the office a favor. It is in section four.
